name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Transparent And Mirror Acrylic Tabletop Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 layers of acrylic for a premium and eye-catching display.
             +) Layer 1: Transparent acrylic (5mm) with 1-sided printing for the main background and design details.
             +) Layer 2: Mirror acrylic (3mm) with engraved detailing for a shiny dimensional effect.
    - Includes a clear acrylic stand (5mm) for stable tabletop display.
    - Mirror acrylic color options include Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic.
    - Smooth-cut edges and durable construction create a polished decorative finish.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
             +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
             +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - The transparent acrylic layer is printed on 1 side using UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - The mirror acrylic layer is engraved to add elegant reflective accents and layered depth.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a freestanding tabletop sign for desks, shelves, mantels, counters, and display tables.
    - The layered acrylic structure creates a standout decorative piece with a stylish 3D look.
    - Easy to assemble by inserting the sign into the included acrylic stand.
    - Lightweight yet durable for indoor decorative use.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, memorial displays, holiday displays, and personalized keepsakes.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, and loved ones.
    - Great for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, memorials, holidays, military appreciation gifts, and seasonal décor.
    - Perfect for creating a custom display piece with a personal message or themed artwork.
    - Ideal for anyone looking for a unique and elegant personalized tabletop decoration.

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer Transparent And Mirror Acrylic Tabletop Sign

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
